response.answer: I’d decline or ask to attend only if you can rest after the overnight coverage. You’ve said normal events and a full workday are manageable when you have slept normally, and that a planning meeting was fine specifically because you had not been awake managing urgent calls overnight. A concise reply: “Thanks for the invitation. As I’m covering the cancellation list overnight beforehand, I won’t be able to attend the Thursday afternoon offsite at my best. Please send any key notes or let me know about a future session.”
